stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: Press wash at a tenth of its price?
stations.note: The import read the ink list.

stations.title: Old import
stations.text: Reads digits and dots, stops at any quote.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Sefton finds press wash priced at a tenth of what it costs.
The old import reads only digits and dots, so the exponent in the ink list is lost.
You write the readers for numbers and texts, escapes included, in three tasks.
Now the whole number is read by its rules, and the price comes out right.
Same ink list, same import, and every price and name reads as written.
